description: Prophecies in the Bible with the passage that makes them, the passages that fulfil them, and an explanation: those made or fulfilled in a passage ("Isa 53", "Matt 2"), those in a category, or all of them by category when called with no arguments.

category.description: A category, by id or by words from its name, e.g. "messiah", "birth", "passion". Call with no arguments to see the categories. Default: all.

edition.description: Edition to quote the verses from: osnb (Norwegian Bokmål), osnn (Norwegian Nynorsk), osen (English), sblgnt (Greek New Testament) or tanach (Hebrew Old Testament). Default: the edition for `language`.

include_text.description: true quotes the prophecy and its fulfilment (at most 200 verses in all); false gives the passages only. Default: false.

language.description: Language for names, notes and study content, and for the links to bible.flogvit.com: en (English), nb (Norwegian Bokmål), nn (Norwegian Nynorsk), sv (Swedish), fr (French), es (Spanish), fi (Finnish), de (German). Content missing in a language falls back to English. Default: en.

mapping.description: Verse numbering to read the reference in and to number the answer in: a mapping id from list_verse_mappings, e.g. "english_kj" (King James), "dnb2024_nb" (Bibelselskapet 2024), or a short name such as "kjv" or "dnb2024". Numberings differ where a psalm heading is a verse or not, and at chapter breaks: Malachi 4:5 in the King James numbering is Malachi 3:23 in osnb. Default: osnb, the site's own numbering, which follows the Hebrew and Greek.

reference.description: A passage; gives the prophecies made in it or fulfilled in it, e.g. "Isa 7:14", "Isa 53", "Matt 2:1-6". Default: none.

name: get_prophecies
title: Prophecies and their fulfilment
